newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Brash won't comment on exporters talks - spokeswoman.
newsitem.headline: Brash won't comment on exporters talks - spokeswoman.

text.p: Reserve Bank of New Zealand Governor Don Brash is not expected to comment on his meeting with exporters on Wednesday afternoon, a RBNZ spokeswoman said on Wednesday.
He will not be participating in a news conference scheduled for 3.30 p.m. (0330 GMT), she added.
Brash is due to take part in a summit meeting to discuss the construction of inflation calculations which she said was of a technical nature only.

The Exporters Summit group, including the Dairy Board, Federated Farmers, Fishing Industry Association, Forest Owners Association, Fruitgrowers Federation, Game Industry Association Manufacturers Federation, Meat Industry Association, Tourism Industry Association, Wine Guild and Wools of New Zealand, is meeting with senior RBNZ and Statistics New Zealand staff to discuss measurement of inflation for the purposes of monetary policy management.
The meeting has been called to discuss possible improvements to the maintenance of price stability.
